div.head: II As 18
div.ab: Seofoðe: þæt nan mon ne sylle nan hors ofer sǽ, buton he hit gifan wille.
Be horsum. Nán man ne sylle nan hors ofer sæ, butan he hit gyfan wille.
Septimum: (Diximus enim) ne quis uendat (dimittat) equum ultra mare, nisi uelit eum dare.
[Be horsum.] Seofoðe: þæt nan mon ne sylle nan hors ofer sǽ, buton he hit gifan wille.
(Von Pferden. Ld) Siebentens: dass niemand ein Pferd über See veräussere, es sei denn, er wolle es verschenken.
(Of horses. Ld) Seventhly: that no one dispose of a horse across the sea, unless he wishes to give it away.
Seventhly: [we declare] that no man shall send any horse across the sea unless he wishes to make a present of it.
